name: hookline
description: Hookline — an autonomous, hook-based party DJ that reads the room.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hookline/web >/dev/null 2>&1; (npm run dev -w @hookline/server & npm run dev -w @hookline/web & wait)
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @hookline/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
